_authoring.purpose: AI reactions and background descriptions for equipped or removed armor.
_authoring.contains: Reaction prompts plus reusable armor-status fragments.
_authoring.perspective: The wearer owns the experience; speaker selection depends on the event.
_authoring.boundary: Does not equip, remove or modify armor.

_help: Edit template text or replace a template with a string array. Keep the documented placeholders. Use MCM Reload Narration JSON after saving.

narrate_armor_equip_1.template: {actor}装备挤奶装甲；它的吸盘吸附在她的乳房上。对附件做出反应。

_authoring.intent: Add erotic flavor to a reaction when a character equips milking armor.

narrate_armor_equip_2.template: 活体盔甲包裹着{actor}。对它的动作和触摸做出反应。

_authoring.intent: Add playful erotic flavor when a character equips living armor.

narrate_armor_equip_3.template: 活体寄生虫装甲连接到 {actor}。对它的动作和触摸做出反应。

narrate_armor_equip_4.template: 这件盔甲从一个被困的宝箱中跳出来，包裹着 {actor}。承认惊喜。

_authoring.intent: Describe the surprise of armor being forced onto the affected character by a trap.

narrate_armor_strip_1.template: {actor}的{armorName}因为奶肿的乳房而脱落。对衣柜事故做出反应。

_authoring.intent: Have a character react to armor coming off as milk-heavy breasts outgrow it.
